0.content: Mavuika could not have foreseen the Traveler five hundred years ago, but after one moment's thought she made them part of her plan, partly because they reminded her of herself. She commissioned Xilonen to forge them an Ancient Name, the first ever for an outlander: Tumaini, "hope". Because of their resistance to the Abyss, only the Traveler could join her final descent into the Night Kingdom, where together they destroyed Gosoythoth. She says Tumaini and Kiongozi are now linked and will live on together. After the war she told the Traveler she had been lost and that their curiosity, exploration and dedication to others showed her the way.

1.content: The First of the Fatui Harbingers came to the Stadium in 5.0, accused Mavuika of failing the oath sworn five hundred years ago, and challenged her for the Pyro Gnosis. She left a searing wound on his chest and felt she was fighting "the pinnacle of human strength". He escaped in a mist from the Masters of the Night-Wind, later traced to Ororon. In 5.1 she rejected his plan to rewrite Natlan's ley lines, which would erase its history like using the Gnosis. He then accepted her plan and lent her his soldiers. After Gosoythoth fell and Ronova came for Mavuika's life at Ochkanatlan, Capitano took her place and fused himself with the Lord of the Night. He argued Natlan still needed its leader, and she came to agree.

2.content: The Masters of the Night-Wind's great shaman is the only person who "inappropriately" knocks on Mavuika's door in her quiet hours, perhaps for the drink, perhaps because they suit each other as drinking buddies. Mavuika says people find Citlali strange, but she ignores trivia and is always there when it counts. Mavuika keeps certain things from her because Citlali tunnel-visions into trouble, but Citlali sees right through her. Citlali, for her part, complains that a visit from Mavuika turned out to be bragging.

3.content: Mavuika wanted a vehicle that was fast, armoured, able to cross cliffs, water and air, explosive enough to be a weapon and summonable with a flick of her wrist. She brought the demand to Xilonen of the Children of Echoes, along with Source Mechanisms she had scoured from Natlan and blueprints she had copied by hand from devices the ancient dragons built against the Abyss. Many explosions later, the two produced a Pyro-compatible prototype. Xilonen declined the test rides, claiming she had "forgotten to make a second helmet". Mavuika praises her as a master who never backs away from a challenge.

4.content: Mavuika's mother Haumia was bold and reckless; her unnamed father was learned and taciturn. The two clashed until their curious, fearless daughter became a bridge between them. Her younger sister Hine was mischievous, quiet by turns and rarely obedient, and Mavuika passed on to her everything she learned. Her Yumkasaur Hitata leapt into her arms whenever he saw her, and Hine would jealously do the same. When Mavuika announced her plan, Haumia gave her blessing and Hine promised to find a way to meet again.

5.content: After the cataclysm, Mavuika's people estimated that the Night Kingdom would fall to the Abyss within five hundred years. Her answer was a plan: the tribes would rebuild, the Wayob would choose six heroes carrying the old heroes' Ancient Names, and she would return to lead one final war. Because Natlan has no god to extend a human life, she placed her life in the Sacred Flame, dying before her time in order to return. Warriors brought her their most precious belongings as fuel full of Contending Fire. She gave each a hot drink and listened to the story behind every item, so their memories would reach the future.

6.content: Mavuika refused every suggestion to use the Pyro Gnosis, before the cataclysm and after, because rewriting the ley lines would erase Natlan's history. In 6.6 (Song of the Welkin Moon Act X), Nicole of the Hexenzirkel arranged a meeting at the sealed Sumeru border. Nahida appeared as a memory, since Dottore lurked in Irminsul. Mavuika guessed the request herself and handed the Gnosis over, saying she had always toyed with giving it to someone who needed it more. Nahida used it to burn the corrupted Irminsul. Afterward the Gnosis could not be found, and Mavuika had already sensed its loss.
